mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (author_id, title, content, view_count, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, author_id as authorId, title, content, view_count as viewCount, is_deleted as isDeleted, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM posts WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.author_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.is_deleted, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.id as user_id, u.email, u.username, u.role, u.status, u.last_login_at, u.created_at as user_created_at, u.updated_at as user_updated_at FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT id, author_id as authorId, title, content, view_count as viewCount, is_deleted as isDeleted, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, author_id as authorId, title, content, view_count as viewCount, is_deleted as isDeleted, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM posts WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, author_id as authorId, title, content, view_count as viewCount, is_deleted as isDeleted, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM posts WHERE author_id = #{authorId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, author_id as authorId, title, content, view_count as viewCount, is_deleted as isDeleted, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM posts WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE is_deleted = 0
